title: calendars/tasks/contacts servers: unsupportedSort for Other
description: Found in JMAP-wf92.11. CalendarEvent/query, Task/query, TaskNotification/query and ContactCard/query handlers never pre-check sort; the memory backends ignore an unknown sort property (contacts compares it as Ordering::Equal; calendars ignores sort entirely). RFC 8620 §5.5: unsupportedSort 'The sort is syntactically valid, but includes a property the server does not support sorting on'. Now that the comparators decode unknown names to <Type>ComparatorProperty::Other, reject Other with unsupportedSort in the handlers, mirroring chat/graph/scene/vtc reject_unsupported_sort + KnownSort.
close_reason: Batch 20 (run wf_770a5fbb-59c): implemented, adversarially verified, full CI green at 8484b9c3
